bio: One of the establishments owned by chef Assaf Granit, Tekés is summed up by its name, which is Hebrew for ceremony. More than a restaurant, it's also a veritable musical extravaganza. The kitchen team puts on a thrilling show, cooking vegetables over an open fire, while the well-drilled waitstaff stand by, ready to spring into action. Flame-grilled leeks with potato and feta purée, fattoush salad with labneh and za'atar, fried gnocchi with yellow curry and yoghurt – just some of the delicious dishes on offer! This culinary journey taking in Levantine tradition and influences from the Middle East embraces intense flavours and carefully selected spices.
